verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents viewing past run logs or manually re-running a failed execution from its failing step. Only adjacent capabilities appear: automatic per-step retries with delay and max attempts, generic checkpointing and fault tolerance for workflows-as-code, and error and recovery handlers on schedules. None of these is the user-initiated inspect-and-resume capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
